_meta.description: Line 2B's stations in order from ESIC Nagar (the first station from D N Nagar) to Mandale, as MMRDA's Line 2B page lists them. 'phase' is the order of opening: 1 Phase I, Mandale to Diamond Garden (open 7 Apr 2026); 2 Phase IA, Chembur (open 13 Aug 2026); 3 the rest, Chembur to D N Nagar, under construction (MMRDA names Phases I and IA; the rest has no MMRDA name). 'kml_name' is the station's point in MMRDA's alignment file. Positions and along_m come from scripts/build-alignment-line2b.py. 'dropped_stations' were in an earlier plan and are not on MMRDA's list now. Names follow MMRDA's list; the full names shown at the open stations are in 'context'.

location.method: MMRDA alignment file for Line 2B (KML on the Metro Influence Zone page, uploaded March 2025): point "ESIC NAGAR (M) STATION". along_m is measured along a centre line derived from MMRDA's corridor polygon, from ESIC Nagar station; the point is 3 m from that line.

context.text: The first station from D N Nagar, where Line 2B leaves Line 2A (Dahisar to D N Nagar).
